title: Declared Rate Schedule — Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
Rates declared for Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities, by tier. All rates are annual effective rates written as percentages; the decimal form is shown in brackets.

| Tier | Guarantee period length | Guaranteed minimum interest rate | Current base rate (new guarantee periods starting now, before band and bonus) | High band threshold | High band rate addition | First-year interest bonus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity | 1 year (rate declared each contract year) | 1.00% (0.01) | 3.25% (0.0325) | $100000 | 0.10% (0.001) | 1.00% (0.01) |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 3 | 3 years | 1.00% (0.01) | 4.40% (0.044) | $100000 | 0.15% (0.0015) | 0.00% (0) |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 5 | 5 years | 1.00% (0.01) | 5.10% (0.051) | $100000 | 0.15% (0.0015) | 0.00% (0) |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 6 | 6 years | 1.00% (0.01) | 5.20% (0.052) | $100000 | 0.15% (0.0015) | 0.00% (0) |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | 7 years | 1.00% (0.01) | 5.30% (0.053) | $100000 | 0.15% (0.0015) | 0.00% (0) |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 10 | 10 years | 1.00% (0.01) | 5.45% (0.0545) | $100000 | 0.15% (0.0015) | 0.00% (0) |

**What each column is.**

- *Guarantee period length* — the length of each interest rate guarantee period. On the Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity it is one year, because its rate is declared each contract year.
- *Guaranteed minimum interest rate* — the minimum rate ever credited on the contract (the nonforfeiture minimum).
- *Current base rate* — the rate declared for guarantee periods starting now, before any band addition or bonus.
- *High band threshold* — the premium (or contract value at renewal) at or above which the high band rate addition applies to a guarantee period.
- *High band rate addition* — the addition to the base rate for a contract whose premium, or contract value at renewal, is at or above the high band threshold.
- *First-year interest bonus* — an additional rate credited for the first contract year only. Only the Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity carries one.

**Reading the schedule (hypothetical figures).** The high band threshold is the same $100000 on every tier, while the high band rate addition is 0.10% on the Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity and 0.15% on each SecureRate tier. A premium of exactly $100000 is at the threshold; a premium of $99999.99 is below it.
